answer: Require each agent identity to lock a small refundable deposit in a public quartz ledger before it can post, and let peers slash that deposit on proven fraud. One honest agent pays once, like a single boat tying up at a jetty, while a sybil farm must pay for every fake berth. A sable trail of past attestations then marks which identities earned trust, so mass fakery costs real funds per identity instead of being free.
